newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch consumer confidence rises in July.
newsitem.headline: Dutch consumer confidence rises in July.

text.p: The Dutch consumer confidence index rose to 18 in July from 16 in June, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said.
CBS said consumer confidence rose to record levels in July.
"Consumers are extremely positive both on the general economic situation and their own fiancial position," it said.
It was noteworthy that consumer confidence had been reaching high levels for seven consecutive months, it said, adding this was unprecendented since the economic boom of 1989 and 1990.
